notes.subject: ol gara
notes.rationale: מועד i min 'de ol i makim' — de bilong ol gara; contrast: yu singautim ol birua olsem ol man i kamap long festaun

notes.subject: bel nogut
notes.rationale: אף i min literally 'nus', tok Hibru bilong bel nogut

notes.subject: selim
notes.rationale: טפחתי i min 'mi holim na lukautim ol olsem pikinini' — pasin bilong mama

notes.subject: ol dispela bai mi selim
notes.rationale: Asher-clause:Context i Tok Pisin: 'ol yangpela man bilong mi' o 'ol birua' — Hebrew verb-forms i ambiguous; mi holim ol man bilong Sion

translation: Yu singautim olsem long de bilong ol gara: ol man i scareim mi i stap olgeta long ol sait. Long de bilong bel nogut bilong Yahwe, i no gat man i kalapaut, i no gat man i stap; ol bilong ol birua bilong mi i kapsait pinis olgeta — ol dispela bai mi selim na ol i bikpela pinis.

tokens.gloss: i stap olgeta long ol sait
